newsitem.title: INDIA: World sugar prices likely under pressure - Baron.
newsitem.headline: World sugar prices likely under pressure - Baron.

text.p: World sugar prices are likely to be under pressure in the 1996/97 season, according to initial indications, Peter Baron, executive director of the London-based International Sugar Organisation (ISO), said on Tuesday.

"Initial indications suggest that for the third consecutive season a large, although lower than in the 1995/96 season, excess of world production over consumption is likely," Baron said in an speech at a three-day sugar conference in New Delhi.
"This might put prices under downward pressure," he said.

"We are facing a third year of surpluses and this should make us a bit cautious on expanding production for export purposes because there will be pressure on the export market, for sure," Baron added.
He was speaking at the start of the three-day Asian International Sugar Conference.
